subject: Post-discovery: plan for ML/Infra deep-dive and scheduling
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.inference>
To: Anna Lopez <anna@clearfield.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.inference>
Date: Fri, 9 Oct 2027 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: Post-discovery: plan for ML/Infra deep-dive and scheduling

Hi Anna — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next step so we can get your ML and infra teams paired with ours for a hands-on technical deep-dive (60–90 minutes).

Goal
- Walk through a small end-to-end inference flow for your core recommendation model, validate latency/cost targets, and identify infra changes needed to run at scale.

Suggested attendees (from both sides)
- Product/Eng sponsor (you)
- 1 ML engineer (model owner)
- 1-2 infra/SRE engineers
- Redwood: Ben (Infra lead), Marissa (Solutions Eng), myself (AE)

Proposed agenda (75 min recommended)
1) 5m — Intros & goals
2) 15m — Current model + workload profile (you)
3) 20m — Redwood runtime architecture & quantization/latency options
4) 25m — Live run: a short demo on a sample request pattern + perf numbers
5) 10m — Next steps / mutual action plan (owners & timeline)

Available windows (PDT) — please indicate preferred slot or share a calendar link: 
- Tue Oct 12: 09:00–10:15, 13:00–14:15
- Wed Oct 13: 10:30–11:45, 15:00–16:15
- Thu Oct 14: 08:30–09:45, 16:00–17:15

Attachments: tdx_agenda.pdf (detailed agenda), mutual_action_plan.xlsx (M A P draft) — feel free to add/remove agenda items.

Next steps: can you confirm 1) preferred slot, 2) internal roster (ML + infra names), and 3) any hard constraints (data residency, firewall egress, air-gapped infra) so we can prep the right demo environment?

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
T: (415) 555-0187
https://redwood.inference

From: Anna Lopez <anna@clearfield.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.inference>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference>
Date: Fri, 9 Oct 2027 15:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-discovery: plan for ML/Infra deep-dive and scheduling

Thanks Tessa — that looks good. We want the session to be hands-on and focus on two things: tail latency at 95th percentile under production load, and an initial cost estimate for our traffic profile.

Attendees from ClearField (tentative):
- Anna Lopez (product)
- Diego Rivera (ML engineer)
- Priya Sinha (infra / SRE)

Preferred slots for us (PDT):
- Wed Oct 13: 10:30–11:45 (favored)
- Thu Oct 14: 08:30–09:45

One ask: can Redwood include someone who manages KV cache & batching behavior in the demo (we think that will be critical)? Also, we have a firewall policy that prevents outbound to unfamiliar IPs — I can send the team’s egress policy before the session.

Hi Anna — Marissa from Solutions Eng here. 

We can absolutely include the engineer who owns KV cache + batching — Ben will lead that portion. Ben, copying you to confirm availability and that you can demo cache warmup behavior and batching tradeoffs.

I attached a short ops runbook (ops_runbook_stub.md) and a checklist we use for demo prep. If you can send Diego’s sample inference trace and a small containerized model artifact (or a serialized checkpoint + input profile), we’ll configure a representative run.

Ben: we’re aiming to lock Wed 10/13 10:30–11:45 PDT. Can you confirm? If not, propose an alternate within the same week.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

Locked: Wed, Oct 13, 2027 10:30–11:45 PDT — I’m available and will run the KV cache / batching section. I’ll bring the perf scripts and a short flamegraph walkthrough.

Quick notes before the session:
- Please upload a small sample trace (<= 10MB) to the secure share link (I’ll DM it to Anna) or send via SFTP.
- If you have a preferred quantized model or a checkpoint, we’ll test that first — otherwise we’ll run a lightweight reproducer.
- Marissa will own the demo environment prep; I’ll own the post-call mutual action plan items on the infra side.

I’ll put a calendar invite shortly with the 75min block and a shared agenda + prep checklist.

Ben Carter
Principal Infra Engineer | Redwood Inference
